create insekto tweaks,The ultimate Create Mod addon for the lazy genius.
---
Stop searching for rare blocks – automate them, and watch as your factory turns you into the master of nature!

Created by me/Insekto, this lightweight NeoForge mod expands your automation capabilities. It utilizes native Minecraft and Create Mod mechanics to make previously uncraftable geological and organic resources fully renewable.✨ FeaturesZero Item Bloat: Uses only existing vanilla and Create Mod items (with the exception of some test items). 

Pure Automation: Turn elusive, non-renewable blocks into automated factory lines using mixers, presses, and crushing wheels. Modern Recipe Logic: Built from scratch using modern Minecraft 1.21.1 data-driven recipes.

Performance Friendly: No heavy scripts or entity lag, just clean and optimized recipe injections.

⚙️ Requirements & CompatibilityMinecraft: 1.21.1Mod Loader: NeoForgeRequired Dependency: **Create Mod** (Must be installed for this mod to function)📜
